references.text: Isaiah 29:13 discusses how people honor God with their lips, but their hearts are far from him, which corresponds to Jesus' message in Mark 7:20 that the inner part of a person is what defines their purity.
Matthew 15:18-20 repeats and expands on Jesus' teaching that what comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what makes a person unclean, directly parallel to Mark 7:20.

Luke 6:45 speaks about how a good person brings forth good things from the good treasure in their heart, while an evil person brings forth evil things, which resonates with the idea in Mark 7:20 that it is the inner self that defines a person's purity.
James 3:6 describes the tongue as a fire and a world of wickedness, which can be seen in light of Jesus' words in Mark 7:20 that what comes out of a person can make them unclean.
